justification: Initial CE-00.3 non-regression budgets, frozen from the measured alpha1 baseline before any core-evolution product behavior change.

pairedRatio.applies: timing and runtime metrics, and memory cells whose baseline CV exceeds memory.maxCv

comparison: Run tools/baselines/measure.mjs with the final plan and both --epoch alpha1=<alpha1 closure> and --epoch <candidate>=<candidate closure> on one machine (--require-quiet is optional). budgets.mjs gate pairs each candidate sample with the adjacent alpha1 sample of the same round, applies the paired-ratio, absolute-memory, deterministic and identity budgets, requires alpha1 to reproduce its frozen deterministic outputs, and lists unknown metrics. Verdicts: pass only when every budget passes; fail on any failing budget, workload-record mismatch, altered alpha1 tarball or policy-chain problem; inconclusive when the run lacks the interleaved control, has too few pairs, exceeds a noise ceiling or cannot resolve a limit; incomplete when a budgeted metric was not run.

changePolicy: budgets.v1.json is generated by `node tools/baselines/budgets.mjs freeze` from this policy and the committed baseline results, and is never edited by hand; rerunning the same freeze command with this policy and the referenced results must reproduce it byte for byte.

Committed policy, budgets, workloads, derivation and baseline result files are immutable; `budgets.mjs gate` compares the budgets file with the version of the commit that added it and fails on any difference.

Changing a threshold, metric set or workload requires a new budget-policy.vN.json and budgets.vN.json (N incremented), a justification, a predecessor reference by path and SHA-256, and a new comparable baseline run of the unchanged alpha1 artifact; reusing an old result file is rejected.
Every budget loosened or removed relative to the predecessor must be listed in `relaxations` with its own justification; an unknown metric may only leave the unknown list by gaining a budget.

No release may pass against a weakened budget retroactively: the gate evaluates the budgets version current at the evaluated commit, fails on any policy-chain problem, and never reports inconclusive or incomplete as pass.
